start.name: The Forest Entrance
start.description: You stand at the edge of a dark forest. A cold wind moves through the trees and a small path leads north.

glade.name: Moonlit Glade
glade.description: You enter a quiet clearing with glowing flowers and a tiny stone shrine.

tavern.name: The End Tavern
tavern.description: You stand inside a crooked inn with a low ceiling, low beams, and a brass bar glimmering beneath a single lamp. The room smells of smoke, damp stone, and faded memories. A heavy wooden door leads east into a forest path, and a locked stone stair drops north into the cellar below.

root_cellar.name: The Lantern Cellar
root_cellar.description: A cold cellar full of dust and old casks. Torch brackets line the stone wall, and a locked iron door waits deeper in the dark. The stairs climb south back to the tavern.

cave_entrance.name: The Cave Mouth
cave_entrance.description: The tunnel narrows into a grim cave. Everything smells of wet stone and old blood. A thin trail of pale light glows in the dark beyond, and you can feel eyes watching from deeper within.

cave_chamber.name: The Beast Den
cave_chamber.description: The cave is full of jagged stone, shattered bones, and glowing eyes in the dark. The floor is slick with old gore, and something in the shadows is breathing.

forest_path.name: Forest Path
forest_path.description: A narrow path winds through pine and dead grass. The air smells of rain and distant thunder. Beyond the trees, the path ends in a small glade with something glinting in the dirt.

old_man.description: An old man with a long beard. He seems to know a lot about the forest.
old_man.dialogue: Beware of the cave, young traveller. It holds many secrets.

mysterious_figure.description: A shadowy figure lurking in the cave. You cannot see their face.
mysterious_figure.dialogue: Leave this place, or face the consequences.

magic_stone.description: A glowing stone that radiates warmth. It is said to have magical properties.

village_key.description: A rusty key that opens the village gate.
